device_analysis.name: Adiabatic Four-Port Splitter / MMI Variant
device_analysis.description: Symmetric cross-shaped device with four rounded petal-like lobes extending orthogonally, connected by tapered stems to a central junction.

iterations.change_made: Initial geometry (elliptical petals too small, ports too short)
Increased petal dimensions, but oversized beyond footprint
Scaled down: petal_width→1.05, petal_length→1.3, better fit to 4.7×4.7 target
Increased width & length slightly, improved recall to 0.84
Fine-tuned petal and stem dimensions, recall→0.877
Pushed too far, overshooting on petal bulges (red overhang)
Backed off, reduced taper_smoothness to 0.62 for sharper petal tips; final best

knob_verification.result: PASS - Component name changed, GDS reflects parametric response

tunables: petal_width_um (controls mode confinement in petal lobes)
taper_smoothness (controls petal bulge shape; lower = sharper tips)
